subject: GreenWave marketplace listing - compliance evidence sync
messages:
From: Ava Turner <ava.turner@greenwave.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenwave.com>, procurement@greenwave.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing - security evidence required for GWave catalog

Hi Logan,

We're moving Redwood into the GreenWave Cloud Catalog (co-sell track) and our compliance team needs the security artifacts for the marketplace review. Specifically they asked for: SOC 2 summary (scope + auditor report), a pen-test attestation/letter, and a copy of your DPA or ingress/egress controls.

Can you share a consolidated package or point us to a secure folder? We need to complete the review by 7/25 to keep the co-sell kickoff next month.

Thanks,
Ava Turner
Security Program Manager
GreenWave Systems
ava.turner@greenwave.com
[Attachment: GreenWave_Marketplace_Evidence_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)]
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ava Turner <ava.turner@greenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing - security evidence required for GWave catalog

Hi Ava — thanks for the list and timeline. We're ready to support that cadence.

Quick plan:
- I'll upload a curated evidence folder (SOC2 summary, pen-test attestation, DPA template + redline guidance) to a secure Drive link by EOD Monday (7/21).
- Ben will validate scope mapping between our SOC2 in-scope systems and the marketplace product surface.
- Marissa will coordinate procurement artifacts and the DocuSign flow.

Attachments I'll include: Redwood_SOC2_summary_v1.pdf, pen_test_letter_redwood_2024.pdf, Redwood_DPA_template.docx. If you need a formal letter from our auditor, we can request the certified report but that may take a few days.

Sharing link after upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cGW-evidence (read-only, expiring link).

Logistics / ask from you: Can you confirm whether GreenWave requires a full SOC 2 Type II PDF or if the summary + auditor attestation cover letter is sufficient for initial listing? Also confirm whether any additional regional data residency attestations are required for the co-sell listing.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_summary_v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Turner <ava.turner@greenwave.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing - security evidence required for GWave catalog

Ava — looping in procurement notes to make sure there are no surprises on timelines. One additional ask from our side: can you confirm whether GreenWave's listing review will require the pen test scope to explicitly mention the marketplace integration surface (API endpoints, ingestion pipelines)? If so, Ben will pull the exact scope mapping and we'll add short tech notes to the pen-test letter.

Also, for DocuSign, who should we prepare the DPA for (name + email)? If procurement@greenwave.com is the central inbox, we can send a primary copy to Marta (marta.ruiz@greenwave.com) and CC procurement.

We aim to have the Drive folder + DocuSign envelope sent by 7/21 EOD. If GreenWave needs anything sooner, flag and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Cloud Partners
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_template.docx (DOCX, 82KB)]
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Turner <ava.turner@greenwave.com>, procurement@greenwave.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing - security evidence required for GWave catalog

Hi team — thanks, this looks good. Confirmed: procurement will accept the SOC2 summary + auditor attestation for the initial OOB review; we may request the full Type II report later in the process. For the pen-test, we do ask that the attestation includes a line tying the test scope to the customer-facing API surface that will be listed in the catalog.

Please send the Drive link and DocuSign to marta.ruiz@greenwave.com and cc procurement@greenwave.com. We'll review the package and aim to complete our checklist by 7/25. If anything blocks us, I'll escalate to the catalog ops team.

Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Lead, GreenWave Systems
marta.ruiz@greenwave.com
